title: Permitted Obstructions
previewText: The provisions of Section 33-42 (Permitted Obstructions) shall apply to all buildings within the Special Southern Hunters Point District, except that dormers provided in accordance with paragraph (b) of Section 23-413 (Permitted obstructions in certain districts) shall be a permitted obstruction in a required setback.
